title: Ohm Brew Double Brew Peach Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Ohm Brew Double Brew Peach Ice highlights the delicate and nectar-like qualities of stone fruit. A wave of soft, ripe Peach greets you on the inhale, full of natural sweetness and floral undertones. The experience is then transformed by a cooling layer of Ice, which sharpens the fruit notes and provides a clean, frosty aftertaste. Formulated with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid is versatile enough for both MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) and RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vaping. It pairs perfectly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.6ohm, ensuring consistent flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Double Brew by the renowned UK mixologists Ohm Brew is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Double Brew provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
